lines.4: --Sports and Martial Arts Festival Preparatory Committee meeting room.
lines.5: Representatives from every committee and club were gathered there.
lines.6: Each committee and club was required to help with preparations for the festival in some way.
lines.8: 「--So, the athletics committee chair is out sick. As a result, preparations have slowed down in several areas.」
lines.10: 「Delays in instructions because the person in charge is absent... It seems to be affecting more than expected.」
lines.11: 「So I propose that members of each committee and club help cover the areas where progress is slow.」
lines.12: 「Cooking club wants help, but we already full with own work.」
lines.13: 「Kishaa! I think that's true for everybody! We all have our own assignments!」
lines.14: Voices of agreement rose from all around.
lines.17: 「Then you're all fine with a shabby festival? Even with television and plenty of other media coming to cover it?」
lines.18: 「Kishaa... Well, it is a festival. We want it flashy.」
lines.19: 「We'll distribute the risk evenly, without putting an overwhelming burden on any one committee or club.」
lines.20: 「Everyone will have to work a little harder. That's the approach.」
lines.21: 「If one more push lets us hold another festival we can proudly show the public, it's worth doing.」
lines.23: 「Yes... If everyone work together, maybe manage.」
lines.24: 「Kishaa! What about drafting more volunteers from students who aren't in clubs?」
lines.25: 「Of course. The assignments will account for that too.」
lines.26: 「I said everyone will work a little harder.」
lines.27: 「Now I'll start assigning the remaining duties.」
lines.35: 「As expected of the Princess... Her command is excellent at times like this.」
lines.36: 「That leaves one thing: cleaning around the school gate.」
lines.38: 「It's both dull and surprisingly hard work.」
lines.39: 「What terrible luck that one annoying job happened to fall through every chain of command and ended up unassigned.」
lines.40: 「Looking at past records, a case like this is rare.」
lines.41: 「Like Iron-senpai said, it's a chain of unexpected problems that normally shouldn't happen...」
lines.43: 「Kishaa! Which club normally cleans the walls by the gate?」
lines.44: 「For some reason, the amateur-radio club. It was abolished this year because it didn't have enough members.」
lines.45: 「I see. If nobody was assigned, no wonder nobody did it.」
lines.47: 「It gets regular cleaning, so the dirt isn't that obvious. But we can't simply leave it.」
lines.48: 「Yes! Then the drama club volunteers for that job.」
lines.50: 「The drama club's regular role is greeting visitors at the gate, so it would be efficient for us to do it... though hard.」
lines.51: 「You're sure? Half-hearted work won't be accepted.」
lines.52: 「That's not even a question. We'll take responsibility and do it right.」
lines.58: 「About that gate-wall cleaning... Are you sure? It's harder than it sounds. It'll put a burden on your members.」
lines.59: 「I could have the younger martial-arts members take it on to build some spirit.」
lines.60: 「No. Our festival assignment is already to hand out pamphlets to visitors at the gate.」
lines.61: 「So I think it makes sense for us to clean the gate too.」
lines.62: 「I'm sure everyone will understand. I'll talk to them tomorrow.」
lines.64: She patted Sunao on the head.
lines.66: 「To be honest, I also thought that contributing here might put us in a better position at the later club-budget meeting.」
lines.68: 「Sorry for asking such a tactless question, Konoe.」
lines.69: 「Not at all. Thank you for worrying about me, Iron-senpai.」
lines.70: 「Heh. I'll treat my cute junior to something at the cafeteria.」
lines.72: 「I'd be sad if you held back.」
lines.75: 「I have my own finances to think about, so no more than twenty.」
